headline: Amazon's Bee launches two new AI wearables
summary: Amazon-owned Bee launched its first new AI devices since being acquired, the Eclipse and Frontier, priced from $74.99, which summarize conversations and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping.

claims.statement: Amazon-owned Bee launched two new AI devices, its first since being acquired by Amazon.

sources.quote: Bee unveils two AI note-taking devices, its first new products since being acquired by Amazon
Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones

claims.statement: The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping.

claims.statement: Prices for the new devices start at $74.99.
